name: skills-paper
description: Research-paper lifecycle skills for GeoAI / deep-learning / GPR projects: plan, find gaps, write (Ge-style), review, and maintain docs.

plugins.name: ai-paper
plugins.description: Write DL/GPR/geophysics/remote-sensing papers or sections in Ge-style; preserves headings and inserts 'Yet to be developed' for unfinished work.

plugins.name: paper-reviewer
plugins.description: Analyze academic paper PDFs from a journal reviewer's perspective and generate a comprehensive review report.

plugins.name: research-gap
plugins.description: Identify research gaps from uploaded papers/links and generate novel research project proposals.

plugins.name: compose-plan
plugins.description: Generate structured development plans for geophysics, GPR, seismic, and AI/ML scientific-computing projects.

plugins.name: ppt-mkl
plugins.description: Research presentations from one .deck source: PPTX with native editable equations, plus Beamer PDF/.tex/.md on the Madrid theme.

plugins.name: doc-tools
plugins.description: Read, maintain, and update research/project documentation (.md/.txt/.pdf/.doc/.xls): doc-reader, documentation-agent, md-updater.
